Read under this build's engine pair {installed 17, comparable_from 14}. Golfer aaron; five entries in three sessions, every one untagged and with no mishit verdict. 2026-09-01/1 (clip-01-1, 12:01, engine 15, score 80, head_sway_norm 0.2) pools, because 15 is not below 14, where frozen Python's rule (below 16) would exclude it as outdated. 2026-09-01/2 (clip-01-2, 12:02, engine 13, score 70, head_sway 0.3) is outdated under both rules: in swings and in excluded, no sample. 2026-09-02/1 is a photo entry (photo-02-1, 12:01, shot_analysis.json at engine 17 naming that photo, carry_distance_yds 150): admitted, where frozen Python names it no_face_on. 2026-09-02/2 (clip-02-2, 12:02, engine 16, score 90, head_sway 0.25) pools under both. 2026-09-03/1 (clip-03-1, engine 17, score 85, head_sway 0.4 and tempo_ratio 3.0) is a drill: untracked, in no swing list and no count, where frozen Python would pool both values. Worked: swing_dirs_seen 5; distinct_swings 4 (01/1, 01/2, 02/1, 02/2; the drill is not a swing of the corpus); built_from_swings 3 and sessions 2 (01/1, 02/1 and 02/2, over 09-01 and 09-02); no club, so no automatic mishit, and mishits_excluded 0. head_sway_norm n 2 over 2 sessions (01/1 and 02/2), each session point n 1 at its first sample's arrival, in isoformat; carry_distance_yds n 1 (02/1). Every claim is refused (center needs 5, spread 10, trend 12 and 3 sessions), so every statistic is null, both findings and the tour standing are withheld, and nothing is sayable. The targets, tolerances, refusal sentences, the carry's two unavailable sentences and head_sway_norm's tour band (p10 0.0294, p90 0.4311, 458 clips, 122 players: ranges.json's) are the rules' and are the same text the recorded career cases carry. tempo_ratio has no sample, and the note names the drill among the reasons, worded as golf_mcp::career's DRILL_IN_THE_NOTE. compare_sessions 09-01 against 09-02: 09-01 holds head_sway n 1, 09-02 carry n 1 and head_sway n 1; each delta null with each side's center refusal, left then right; the scores are get_session_summary's, a mean over every scored swing in the session whoever hit it and whatever its engine: (80 + 70) / 2 = 75.0 over 2, and 90.0 over 1, since the photo entry has no analysis.json and so no score. Against 09-03: the drill's session contributes nothing and its summary still scores it (85.0 over 1), so the sampleless sentence is the drill's, and not frozen Python's re-upload sentence, which would be false here.
